item.title: Government notifies streamlined regulatory approvals for Andaman offshore seismic survey operations
item.description: The Directorate General of Hydrocarbons in coordination with Ministry of Defence issues single-window clearance protocol for 2D and 3D marine seismic surveys in Andaman-Nicobar offshore basin.
